Hannah,

Following up on the SIG intake call last week — Bluecrest is progressing on our vendor SIG and needs a compact collection of encryption and key management artifacts to close the control set. Specifically we need: 1) documented key rotation schedule and last rotation proofs for production KMS; 2) HSM attestation for the tenant split key ceremony you referenced; 3) sample rotation logs covering the last 12 months; and 4) a short readme describing separation-of-duties for key material access.

Can you confirm what you can provide by EOD Thursday? We're packaging these items into our CAIQ/SIG bundle. If there are any export or redaction constraints (PII/metadata), please call that out.

Thanks,

Director, Security Assurance
Bluecrest Financial

Evelyn — thanks for the clear list. We can provide all four items; please find the plan below and the expected delivery windows.

Quick answers up-front:
- Key rotation schedule + signed rotation marker: we will export the last 12 rotation markers and a schedule doc (rw_kms_rotation_checklist_v1.2.pdf). Delivery: tomorrow (Tue) EOD.
- HSM attestation: we have a tenant-level attestation from the HSM vendor and a notarized seal for the split ceremony. Delivery: Wed morning.
- Rotation logs (sample): a CSV export with scrubbed principal IDs and tenant pseudonyms. Delivery & redaction note: logs will not include unmasked user IDs; we'll provide mapping guidance in the readme.
- Separation-of-duties readme: short doc describing roles (crypto-ops, infra, vendor custodians) and manual controls.

Operational notes and asks:
1) Custody vendor (cc'ed) will provide the HSM-signed attestation artifact. Can Custodian confirm they can push the vendor attestation to the shared Drive link or do you prefer a direct SFTP?
2) For rotation logs we will redact principal identifiers per our internal policy; if your audit needs full-resolution identities we can discuss a controlled on-site review or a limited-scope remap under NDA.

I'll attach the checklist now and we will follow up with the exports as they are prepared.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Hi all — technical follow-ups from the export team.

Notes: 
- Rotation log export: we will include columns: timestamp (UTC), key_id (tenant-scoped), event_type (rotate/create/destroy), actor_role (crypto-ops/vendor), and vendor-signature-id. We will drop IP and full user principals. Example sample file: rotation-logs-2028-2029.csv.
- HSM attestation: attached is the vendor attestation (hsm-attestation-2029-04-01.pdf). It includes the split-key ceremony summary, signing certificate chain, and the vendor timestamp.
- Proof-of-rotation markers: each rotation entry contains a signed marker; we will provide the markers separately in the rotation export and as a packaged tarball if Bluecrest prefers.

Redaction rules applied: tenant pseudonymization, scrubbing of user-level principals, and SHA256 hashes of any referenced key handles when required. If you need the original key handle blobs for cryptographic verification, we require a data-handshake that includes a limited-scope NDA amendment.

Delivery ETA: 
- Rotation CSV + markers: Tue 2029-04-30 17:00 PDT
- Full HSM attestation: Wed 2029-05-01 09:00 PDT (vendor will upload)

I can also provide a short verification walkthrough (30 minutes) to talk through the CSV and how to validate the signature chains. Let me know preferred times.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Crypto Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- hsm-attestation-2029-04-01.pdf (PDF: vendor-signed HSM attestation)
- rotation-logs-2028-2029.csv (CSV: sample rotation entries, pseudonymized)
- redwood-kms-export-readme.txt (TXT: instructions for verification and redaction notes)
